01 — About

A bit about me

I'm a BCA graduate who started with curiosity about how software is built and ended up equally fascinated by how it's experienced. That combination — design and development, with a growing interest in data — is where I feel most at home.

My degree covered AI, machine learning, data warehousing, and design thinking. Outside class, I've been building projects that let me practice the full loop: understanding a problem, designing around it, and shipping something that works.

I'm drawn to roles in UI/UX, product, analytics, or tech consulting — places where the output is a decision or an experience, not just a feature. I like working with ambiguity and prefer thinking through trade-offs to following a predetermined script.

When I'm not at a screen, I'm likely involved in something cultural — I helped plan events for the Hindi Association and have done community work through NSS and Diyaghar NGO.

03 — Work

Selected projects

01
Full-Stack · Maps · Real-time data

SpotMyEvent

A location-based event discovery platform. Users can search by place name, see nearby events on an interactive map, and get distance-sorted results — all in a single clean interface. Built the full stack: geocoding, Haversine filtering, real-time event ingestion, and a ticket-booking flow.

ReactNode.jsExpressLeafletSerpAPIGeoapifyMongoDB

02
Machine Learning · Text Classification

AI Spam Classifier

A Naive Bayes text classifier with TF-IDF preprocessing. The focus was on understanding the precision/recall trade-off and building something that actually generalises well. Evaluated on real-world SMS datasets.

PythonScikit-learnTF-IDFNaive BayesJupyter
GitHub ↗
03
Android · Mobile · Local Storage

Finance Tracker

A native Android app for personal expense tracking — categorised income and expenses, transaction history, and reminders. Designed the XML-based UI with Material Design guidelines and SQLite for local persistence.
